description: This file implements the GstWrapper class and related factory functions for creating and managing GStreamer objects, including setting caps and structures, within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: GstWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to interact with GStreamer structures and caps.

classes.name: IGstWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating GstWrapper instances.

classes.name: GstWrapperFactory
classes.description: Implementation of the IGstWrapperFactory interface, managing singleton instances of GstWrapper and its factory.

methods.name: GstWrapper::gstCapsSetSimple
methods.description: Sets simple caps on a GstCaps object using variable arguments.

methods.name: GstWrapper::gstStructureNew
methods.description: Creates a new GstStructure with a specified name and initial field.

methods.name: GstWrapper::gstStructureSet
methods.description: Sets fields on a GstStructure using variable arguments.

methods.name: IGstWrapperFactory::getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton factory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: IGstWrapperFactory::getGstWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton GstWrapper instance, creating it if necessary.
